overview.grain: One row per player appearance in a game.
overview.modeling_notes: Useful for pre-transfer form and post-transfer sporting outcomes. player_club_id is the club at the appearance; player_current_club_id is a current snapshot and may leak future information.

overview.grain: One row per club in a game (normally two club-perspective rows per game).
overview.modeling_notes: Team-perspective match results and context; suitable for rolling club-strength features when time-filtered.

overview.grain: One row per club; mostly a current/latest scraped snapshot rather than a historical panel.
overview.modeling_notes: Club dimension. Several attributes describe the latest scrape, not the historical transfer date, and therefore should not be used naively in backtests.
Competition dimension; generally safe descriptive context when definitions are stable.
Country dimension; generally safe descriptive context when definitions are stable.

overview.grain: One row per recorded in-game event.
overview.modeling_notes: Event-level source for granular outcomes; aggregate by player/club and strictly respect event date.

overview.grain: One row per player listed in a game lineup or substitutes list.
overview.modeling_notes: Lineup/position source; can derive selection and role outcomes after transfer or pre-transfer role features.
Game spine for dates, results, clubs, competitions, and attendance; filter national-team games where club analysis is intended.

overview.grain: One row per national team; mostly a current/latest scraped snapshot.
overview.modeling_notes: National-team snapshot; current values/rankings are not historical unless separately dated.

overview.grain: One row per player valuation observation date.
overview.modeling_notes: Time-stamped financial series. Nearest valuation on or before transfer can be a feature; later valuations can define financial return at a fixed horizon.

overview.grain: One row per player; current/latest attributes are snapshot fields.
overview.modeling_notes: Player identity dimension. Birth, citizenship, foot, position, and height are useful; current club, contract, current value, caps, goals, agent, and last_season may reflect a later snapshot and can leak.

overview.grain: One row per recorded player movement between clubs on a transfer date.
overview.modeling_notes: Likely modeling-event spine. Includes future-dated and non-fee movements, so scope rules are required. Zero fees may mean free transfer, loan, return, or undisclosed rather than a true zero purchase price.
